name: Rothenberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rothenberg (a black eagle above a yellow antler on red).
history: Flag of a former municipality: Rothenberg merged with Beerfelden, Hesseneck and Sensbachtal into the city of Oberzent on 1 January 2018.

features.role: Rothenberg arms — eagle and antler on red
